title: The 10 Best Rice Cookers Under $100
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for rice cookers under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at rice cookers under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Zojirushi NS-TSC10 Micom Rice Cooker
products.blurb: Key specs: Fuzzy logic (Micom) microcomputer, 5.5-cup uncooked capacity, Nonstick spherical inner pot.
strengths: Zojirushi's inner pot coating outlasts the non-stick aluminum used in budget models
Keep-warm quality noticeably better than basic thermostat cookers at the 4 to 6 hour mark
Retractable cord and detachable lid simplify storage and cleaning
limitations: 5.5-cup capacity is modest for large families compared to 10-cup budget models
No induction heating or pressure cooking at this price tier
features: White, sushi, brown, and quick-cook settings

products.name: Toshiba Rice Cooker with Fuzzy Logic TRCS01
products.blurb: Key specs: Fuzzy logic temperature control, 6-cup uncooked capacity, Stainless steel inner lid.
strengths: Fuzzy logic at a price point where competitors only offer single-thermostat control
6-cup capacity handles a household of 4 without stepping up in price
LCD countdown display removes guesswork on remaining cook time
limitations: Brown rice results are noticeably less consistent than Zojirushi's fuzzy logic
Plastic body and controls feel less durable than the metal-accented Zojirushi
Shorter track record and smaller review base than the established Japanese brands

products.name: Panasonic SR-DF181 10-Cup Fuzzy Logic Rice Cooker
products.blurb: Key specs: Panasonic fuzzy logic, 10-cup uncooked capacity, Diamond-fluorine coated inner pot.
strengths: 10-cup capacity is nearly double the Zojirushi NS-TSC10 at a lower price
Diamond-fluorine coating resists scratching better than standard non-stick
limitations: Less widely distributed in the US, making parts and support harder to find
Brown rice consistency trails the Zojirushi at large fill levels
Bulkier footprint than the 5.5-cup models given the 10-cup capacity

products.name: Aroma Housewares ARC-914SBD Digital Rice Cooker
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-cup uncooked capacity, Single-thermostat cook/warm switch, Digital display.
strengths: Highest-volume budget rice cooker on the market with a large, established review base
8-cup capacity covers family use at a fraction of a fuzzy logic model's price
Digital display and steam tray are uncommon extras at this price point
limitations: Single-thermostat control means no adjustment for brown rice or specialty grains
Inconsistent results at maximum 8-cup fill level
Non-stick coating typically wears within 1 to 3 years of daily use

products.name: Hamilton Beach Rice Cooker 20 Cups Cooked
products.blurb: Key specs: 20-cup cooked capacity, Single-thermostat cook/warm switch, Nonstick removable inner pot.
strengths: 20-cup cooked capacity serves large families or gatherings at a budget price
Removable inner pot and glass lid simplify cleanup and monitoring
Included accessories (scoop, tray, measuring cup) add value at this price
limitations: Basic thermostat produces uneven results at or near maximum capacity
No brown rice or specialty settings
Larger footprint takes up significant counter space
features: Rice scoop and measuring cup included

products.name: Zojirushi NHS-06 Rice Cooker/Steamer 3 Cup
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-cup uncooked capacity, Simple cook/steam/warm switch, Nonstick inner pot.
strengths: Zojirushi reliability and inner pot quality in a compact 3-cup size
Steaming basket adds vegetable and fish steaming without a separate appliance
Small footprint suits dorm rooms and studio kitchens
limitations: No fuzzy logic, single-thermostat control like budget brands
3-cup ceiling means two cycles for larger households
Priced closer to fuzzy logic competitors despite basic thermostat control

products.name: Tiger JKT-S10U Micom Rice Cooker
products.blurb: Key specs: Tiger MICOM fuzzy logic, 5.5-cup uncooked capacity, Tacook synchro-cooking plate.
strengths: Tacook plate lets you steam a protein above the rice while it cooks simultaneously
Tiger MICOM fuzzy logic brings brown rice and sushi settings competitive with Zojirushi
Retractable cord and nonstick pot match Zojirushi's convenience features
limitations: Tiger's grain texture runs slightly firmer than Zojirushi, a preference-dependent tradeoff
Fewer menu settings than Zojirushi's Neuro Fuzzy line
Smaller US review base and service network than Zojirushi
features: White, brown, sushi, and porridge settings

products.name: Aroma Housewares ARC-5000SB 20-Cup
products.blurb: Key specs: 20-cup cooked capacity, Digital display with delay timer, Nonstick removable inner pot.
strengths: Digital delay timer at a budget price point most single-thermostat cookers lack
20-cup capacity handles large batches or events without stepping up in price
Removable inner pot simplifies cleanup versus fixed-pot competitors
limitations: No fuzzy logic, so brown rice and specialty grains cook inconsistently
Large footprint requires significant counter or storage space
Build quality feels less substantial than Zojirushi or Tiger at nearly the same size

products.name: COSORI Rice Cooker 10 Cup
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-cup uncooked capacity, Digital one-touch presets, Nonstick ceramic-coated inner pot.
strengths: 10-cup capacity with digital presets undercuts comparable Zojirushi and Panasonic pricing
Ceramic-coated pot avoids the PTFE non-stick used in cheaper budget cookers
Preset menu covers brown rice and mixed grains without manual timing
limitations: Newer brand in the category with a shorter track record than the Japanese and Korean incumbents
Brown rice results are adequate but not as consistent as dedicated fuzzy logic algorithms
Larger 10-cup body takes more counter space than 5.5-cup mid-range models
features: White, brown, mixed, and steam settings

products.name: Black+Decker RC506 3-Cup Rice Cooker
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-cup uncooked capacity, Single cook/warm switch, Nonstick removable bowl.
strengths: Lowest price in this roundup for a functional, reliable rice cooker
Compact 3-cup size fits small kitchens and dorm setups
Simple one-switch operation with no learning curve
limitations: Single-thermostat design cannot handle brown rice consistently
3-cup ceiling is too small for households of 3 or more
Non-stick coating and switch mechanism tend to wear within 1 to 2 years of daily use
features: Rice measuring cup and spoon included

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
